rules.title: How to Play Jambo
rules.objectiveText: Win rounds by playing the highest card of the leading suit. After 5 rounds, the player with the most credits wins the game.
rules.turnFlowText1: The first player chooses any card from their hand and leads the round.
rules.turnFlowText2: Going clockwise, each other player must play a card of the same suit if they have one.
rules.turnFlowText3: If a player cannot follow suit, they may play any card.
rules.turnFlowText4: Once all 4 players have played, the round ends.
rules.winningRoundText1: The highest card of the leading suit wins the round.
rules.winningRoundText2: Cards that do not follow the leading suit cannot win.
rules.winningRoundText3: The winner collects 30 credits (3 opponents × 10 bet).
rules.winningRoundText5: The round winner leads the next round.
rules.koraText: If the winning card of a round is a 3 (the lowest rank), it triggers a Kora:
rules.koraText1: The bet is doubled to 20 credits per player.
rules.doubleKoraText: If the winning card is a 3 AND no one followed the leading suit, it triggers a Double Kora:
rules.doubleKoraText1: The bet is quadrupled to 40 credits per player.
rules.gameEndText1: The game ends after all 5 rounds are played.
rules.gameEndText2: The player with the most credits at the end wins the game.
rules.gameEndText3: If the final round is a Kora or Double Kora, the game status reflects that.
